Training routes
Adult SSC slaves with a fully developed uterus can choose this specialization. Complete training sessions, whole rituals, active teaching and baby play build progress. Teaching counts even without student skill gains. Care training has no daily cap and remains available with fertility disabled. Successful childbirth will also grant progress (coming later).

Features
Progress improves fertility, shortens new pregnancies and improves teaching and baby play. Ordinary completion is planned to unlock preconception choices for offspring sex, species following the bearer or partner, and an initial offspring imprint (coming later).

Finalization
Complete ordinary fertility training, process the corresponding personality gel at a sculpting table, then reimplant it to further improve fertility, teaching and baby play. Targeted Gestation and self-cloning will be added later.
